Initial release of the persona-team-lead skill.

- Enables running standups, coordinating tasks, and team communication.
- Integrates with calendar, email, chat, drive, and sheets via prerequisite utility skills.
- Provides workflows for standup reports, meeting preparation, weekly digests, and converting emails to tasks.
- Includes step-by-step instructions and practical tips for effective team leadership.
